summary: R2_FASTEST_CURRENT_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_LANE_PRESERVE_ORDER. The frozen 2026-08-10T12:28:53Z snapshot and exact contracts prove R2 is the sole current lane with a bounded near-term complete-inventory clock: it is PRE_START at 0/14, begins with the complete 2026-08-11 UTC day, and can first have its required 14 contiguous days only after the 2026-08-24 UTC day closes and is accepted. Receipt, integrity, handoff and interpretation latency remain conditional, so that date is an inventory boundary rather than a guaranteed terminal learning time. R1 is second among deterministic clocks: it is 4/90 with lag 0 but cannot be reviewed before 2026-11-04 and remains mechanism-neutral discovery evidence. Post-shock is a slower independent conditional lane requiring at least eight eligible shocks, two UP, two DOWN, both chronological halves, three UTC months, concentration gates, terminal Manager review, untouched future evidence and a later point-in-time fill; no lawful completion date can be guaranteed or estimated. The accepted public-source disposition is NO_PUBLIC_FACTOR_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_READY_WAIT, so that branch has no ready point-in-time transport. The accepted carry disposition is DEFER_CARRY_INSTALL_PRESERVE_R2, making carry dependent on an observable R2 terminal disposition rather than a parallel near-term lane. Preserve R2 as the primary mechanism lane and retain R1 and post-shock as slower independent evidence lanes. Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effects are zero; all predictive and economic value remains MISSING_PROOF.
